question: Who wrote the Panchatantra, a collection of fables?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishnu Sharma.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Panchatantra:-**

 
 
• It is a **collection of fables** that originated in India.
 
• The author of the Panchatantra is believed to be **Vishnu Sharma, a Brahmin scholar **who lived in ancient India.
 
• The Panchatantra consists of** five volumes**, each of which contains a set of interconnected stories that teach moral lessons.
 
• The stories in the Panchatantra have been translated into many **languages** and have been adapted into various forms of** art, including plays, movies, and cartoons.**
 
• The Panchatantra is considered one of the **oldest and most influential works** of Indian literature.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rumi:-**

 
 
• He was a **13th-century Persian poet **and mystic who is known for his spiritual writings and poetry.
 
 
 
• **Jaya Dev:-**
 
 
• He** **was a **12th-century poet **from India who is known for his **devotional poetry** and for being the author of the Gita Govinda, a well-known Sanskrit text.
